headline: Dissolves dead skin cells and sebum inside pores
subhead: A gentle exfoliant for combination and oily skin that helps reduce oiliness and blackheads.
proof_points: RonaCare Salicylic Acid Extra Pure from Merck, Germany
With Oligopeptide-10 and EGCG from green tea
